Bought 2 of these packs for my team as a thank you, so spent a fair amount of money. Went to check the Chipotle website for balances (just in case, I had read the reviews on these cards and wanted to be safe), and none of the cards were active according to the website or couldn’t be found. Called Amazon Customer Support (they were a bit unhelpful honestly) and they told me to go to a Chipotle store to have them check/activate the cards. The Chipotle employee swiped each and they were fully active, correct amounts, and ready for use (they can only activate cards purchased in store and from the company itself).
TLDR: Don’t use the Chipotle website to check, go to a store or call their support if you want to check. Also, to clarify for some people, you can’t use a gift card as a partial payment online (like most retailers)! You can do this in store, but online is a no go.

If you are issuing a refund to the original card used, do not complicate the process by then sending an email for an amazon gift card that was neither wanted or requested. title: Can Do It From Home
text:
Usually I either receive an Amazon gift card as a birthday and/or Christmas gift or I purchase them at a store. Then it's very easy to add the amount to my gift card balance using my cell phone. Well I was stuck inside for several days due to a blizzard and I bought quite a few books then due to a travel ban I could not go to the store to purchase a gift card.
So after checking my Gift Card Balance I saw that I had overindulged and it needed to be topped up. One of the options under Manage Your Balance was to Reload Your Balance. I had never used this option but decided to try it. It was so easy to do and I didn't have to leave the comfort of my home. I will be using it again in the future.
